NDT ERP for Sugar Land inspection companies: the direct answer

For NDT and inspection companies with an office in Sugar Land, Stafford or elsewhere in Fort Bend County, the Atlantis ERP solution runs the whole business from one system: technician certificates and vision tests, instruments and calibration, crew dispatch to plants across greater Houston, method-specific field reports, quotations, invoices and the financial picture. It is set up around how your company already works, it runs in a browser and on a phone, and it is fully customizable. Pricing is quote on request.

This section is for owners, operations managers, QA/QC managers and Level IIIs whose office is in Sugar Land but whose technicians spend their days at the Ship Channel, in Freeport, in Texas City or at fabrication shops along Beltway 8, and sometimes on rotation overseas. It is about making the office and the field share one set of records.

Why so many inspection companies run from Sugar Land

Sugar Land is an office town inside one of the largest concentrations of inspection work in the world. From Fort Bend County a crew can reach the Houston Ship Channel refineries and chemical plants, the Texas City and Baytown complexes, and the Freeport chemical and LNG cluster in Brazoria County, all within a normal morning drive.

  • Energy technology and oilfield equipment: SLB has run a large technology and operations campus in Sugar Land since the early 1950s, and the city lists energy firms such as CVR Energy among its major employers. Oilfield tool manufacturing and repair shops in the Sugar Land and Stafford area bring MT, PT, UT and hardness work on machined and welded parts.
  • Power generation: NRG's W.A. Parish Generating Station near Thompsons in Fort Bend County is one of the largest power plants in the country, and outages there bring boiler, piping and pressure-equipment inspection.
  • Refining and petrochemicals: Ship Channel, Baytown, Texas City and Freeport plants run continuous maintenance inspection and large turnarounds.
  • Fabrication and pipeline: shops across southwest and west Houston build pressure vessels, skids and piping spools, and pipeline construction runs across the region.
  • International rotation work: Houston-area contractors often send technicians to Latin America, West Africa and the Middle East, where reports must satisfy foreign clients and classification societies.

The result is a company whose office, yard and crews are rarely in the same place. NDT software for a Sugar Land company has to keep all of them working from the same records.

Inspection management software that connects office, yard and field

Inspection management software in greater Houston is mostly a dispatch problem. Dozens of technicians, several client sites a day, turnarounds that start and stop on the client's timeline, and traffic on US-59 and the Beltway that turns a 40-minute drive into 90.

In the Atlantis ERP each job is a team assignment that moves through planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed, with site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates. Plant gates, laydown yards and shop bays can all be located precisely. Each technician has an availability calendar with assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable days, and Time Off feeds the same calendar. Overlapping entries are refused, double-booking of a technician is blocked, and double-booking of an equipment serial number is blocked.

Operations sees each technician's status, current assignment, utilisation percentage and next available date in calendar, kanban or list views. Utilisation is the number owners in this market watch most closely, because an idle Level II on a Houston payroll is expensive and a busy one turned away is lost work. See the team assignments app. If you want to see your own crew and client list loaded, request a dispatch demo for a Sugar Land company.

Technician certification tracking software, including Texas radiographer cards

A Houston-area inspection company can carry technicians under several qualification systems at once: the company's SNT-TC-1A written practice, client-specified CP-189, ISO 9712 or PCN for international work, and for RT crews, the Texas industrial radiographer certification issued under the Department of State Health Services rules in 25 TAC §289.255, with its ID card. Technician certification tracking software has to hold all of these without a separate spreadsheet for each.

Each certification in the Atlantis ERP records scheme (SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP or other), level from trainee to III, method, certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates, industry sector, OJT hours, training hours, exam results and attachments. The Texas radiographer card is held under "other" with its dates and a scanned copy attached. Status is computed automatically as active, expiring soon within 90 days, expired or revoked, with menus for expiring and expired certificates.

Vision tests are recorded with near vision to Jaeger J1 or J2, far vision, colour perception, contrast, examiner, clinic, file and expiry. Examination sheets hold general, specific and practical scores against a passing score that defaults to 70 percent. Certificate templates per scheme set validity in months, vision test and exam requirements, and minimum OJT and training hours. Daily checks create warning tasks 90 days before a certificate or vision test lapses, configurable daily email alerts go to the people you choose, and timesheets warn when a technician's certificate is not valid. The employee NDT profile adds highest level, methods certified, radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry. See the certificates app.

Calibration management software for a Houston-sized instrument pool

A mid-size Houston contractor can own hundreds of serialised items: flaw detectors, PAUT units, thickness gauges, eddy current and IRIS kits, PMI analysers, hardness testers, yokes, UV lamps, probes, wedges and reference blocks. Calibration management software has to know where each one is, who has it and when it is due.

The Atlantis ERP tracks every item by serial number with type, assigned person, condition, asset tag, firmware, accessories and lifecycle stage: new, active, in calibration, in repair, rented out, retired or disposed. Rental details can be recorded for units you hire out to other contractors or hire in for a peak. Issue and return run through supervisor and manager approval with condition recorded at both ends. Reservations stop two crews claiming the same kit, and inbound and outbound movements are logged.

Calibration records hold provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag, pass, fail or conditional result and next due date. The calibration certificate register stores lab accreditation number, PDF and valid, expiring or expired status with alerts. Team assignments warn when assigned equipment is out of calibration. The maintenance log records preventive, corrective, repair, cleaning, firmware update and probe replacement work with condition before and after. Purchase records vendors as OEM, dealer or calibration lab, with an accredited-lab flag, accreditation number and expiry, and order lines tied to a specific serial. Consumables carry reorder levels and low-stock flags. See the asset management app.

NDT reporting software that clients on the Gulf Coast accept

Gulf Coast owners are demanding about report format. Many have their own templates and will reject anything else. NDT reporting software here has to produce the client's format from your data, not force the client to accept yours.

The Atlantis ERP includes 17 report types, each with its own numbering: UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ECT, IRIS, PAUT, MFL, TOFD, PWHT, PMI, hardness, UT thickness, ferrite, holiday/coating and computed radiography. UT reports include a probe calibration table; RT reports record source, technique, IQI type and placement; MT records technique and particle type; PT records method and developer; PAUT records focal laws; MFL records scan mode and item lines; UT thickness readings are held by direction. Weld and job lines record defect type and orientation, and results are acceptable, not acceptable or acceptable with remarks.

Reports run draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures and a third-party or authorized inspector field. Work order, request, WPS, contract, drawing, procedure and standard references are captured. Versioned company templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML carry your branding, and Excel templates are filled by mapping fields to cells, which is how a plant's own spreadsheet format gets produced without retyping. For offshore and marine rotation work, marine mode adds a vessel cover page and photo, and merges the class-society certificate (DNV, ABS, Lloyd's Register, BV, RINA, IRS or ClassNK), the inspector's Level II certificate and the calibration certificate into the PDF. More on Digital Twin Reporting Software.

Offline field capture for plants, shops and overseas sites

Signal is unreliable inside plants, in shop bays with steel roofs and at many overseas locations. The Atlantis field app installs from the browser onto a phone or tablet and works without signal. Technicians pick the method, fill in the report, take photos, sign on screen and preview the PDF; drafts and photos are stored on the device and sync when a connection returns.

The field API lets each device pull the jobs assigned to that technician and the equipment issued to them, then submit reports and sync. For a technician on a rotation in another country, that means the same app and the same report formats as at home, with reports arriving in the Sugar Land office for review and approval as soon as the device reconnects. Whether devices are allowed in a particular client area is the client's rule; your procedure for it is configured during implementation.

Radiography crews and Texas radiation control

Texas is an NRC Agreement State, and the Department of State Health Services Radiation Control Program licenses industrial radiography and certifies radiographers. RT companies in greater Houston are inspected on personnel, training, dosimetry, equipment and vehicles.

In the ERP, the employee NDT profile stores radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry, and the Texas radiographer certification sits with the technician's other certificates. The Fleet app records each vehicle's purpose, whether it can carry radioactive sources, its transport licence number and expiry, and assignments to projects and drivers with dates and mileage. RT and computed radiography reports record source, technique and IQI details.

How you organise source inventories, utilisation logs and leak test records for your licence is configured during implementation with your Radiation Safety Officer. The ERP holds the records the programme needs; it does not replace the programme.

Procedures and document control for audit-heavy clients

Refinery and chemical clients around Houston audit procedures regularly, and many require client approval of a procedure revision before it is used on their site. The Atlantis ERP procedure register holds document number, revision, method (UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ET, TOFD, PAUT, LT, AE, hardness, PMI, CR, DR and more), scope, material, applicable standard such as ASME Section V, acceptance criteria and body text or an uploaded file.

Procedures move through draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, with rejected and archived states. Prepared, reviewed and approved by are recorded with dates, approved revisions are locked, rejections need a reason, and each revision keeps a full snapshot. Approvers receive email notifications and reminders. An AI-assisted first draft, falling back to a built-in template, handles routine documents, and a Level III still reviews and approves. Company certifications, such as ISO registration and client approvals, are tracked with alert days. For written practice or procedure support, see NDT consulting. Atlantis NDT training is SNT-TC-1A based.

NDT quoting, invoicing and the numbers owners watch

In a competitive market like Houston, margin is won or lost on accurate quoting and complete invoicing. Quotations in the Atlantis ERP record job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, with NDT service products flagged by method and category, a global discount and a branded PDF. Clients accept and sign online, and the quote becomes a sales order.

Projects carry job type, site, client PO, contract, methods, codes, scope, acceptance criteria, assigned equipment and technicians, and safety induction and work permit fields. Timesheets record work type (inspection, travel, standby, setup), method, billable flag, multiplier, site, client and equipment serial, with approval, and feed billing. Invoices carry project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with labour, equipment and consumables subtotals and lines by cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician and days or hours.

The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA, outstanding invoices, bills and expenses over twelve months. KPI dashboards show calibration due and overdue, certificates expiring and expired, and issued equipment overdue for return. Cost centres let a company with a Sugar Land office and a yard elsewhere see each operation's contribution. Texas sales tax treatment is configured during implementation.

Best NDT ERP for small NDT companies in Fort Bend County

Not every Sugar Land inspection company is large. Plenty are a Level III owner with a small crew, working as a subcontractor to bigger firms. For them, the best NDT ERP is one that starts small: certificates, calibration, reports and invoicing, with CRM and purchasing later.

Implementation maps your methods, job types, certification matrix, instruments and client formats, imports existing spreadsheets, sets up branded templates and pilots on live jobs. It runs in a browser and on phones, so there is nothing to host. For growth, the CRM records service line, lead source, NDT service type, industry sector, site country and estimated technicians and days, scores leads 0 to 100, imports CSV lists and runs drip email sequences, and business cards collected at Houston industry events become leads from a photo. Surveys handle competency questionnaires and client feedback. The eLearning portal and the Practical NDT 3D simulator support Level I and II trainees. To see a version sized for a small crew, book a demo for a small Fort Bend County company.

Integrations with owner and accounting systems

Large Gulf Coast owners run SAP or Maximo, and some want inspection data delivered into their systems. The Atlantis ERP has an open REST API and integrates with SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation. For clients who want to see results on their equipment, Atlantis Digital Twins places indications and damage on a 3D model and trends thickness and remaining life.

Frequently asked questions

Is there NDT ERP software for inspection companies in Sugar Land, TX?

Yes. The Atlantis ERP is built for NDT and inspection companies and is configured for your Sugar Land operation during implementation, covering certificates, calibration, dispatch across greater Houston, field reports, quotations and invoicing. Quote on request.

Can it hold Texas radiographer certifications?

Yes. They are recorded as certificates under the "other" scheme with issue and expiry dates and a scanned copy of the ID card, alongside SNT-TC-1A and any other schemes the technician holds.

Can it produce a client's own report spreadsheet?

Yes. Excel templates are filled by mapping report fields to cells, so a plant's own format is produced from your report data.

Does it work for technicians on overseas rotation?

Yes. The offline field app works without signal and syncs later, site country is recorded on leads, and marine mode supports class-society reports.

Can we see margin by job?

Timesheets and equipment use feed invoice lines with labour, equipment and consumable subtotals, and the financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin and EBITDA over twelve months.

How do we get a quote?

Share your headcount, methods and main problem through the contact form. We will demo on your own job types and send a tailored quote. Affordable, accessible, fully customizable.
